definitions.gloss: top-tier; world-class; superb; of the highest caliber
definitions.explanation: Exceeding even first-rate quality. Used to describe people, skills, products, or organizations that are among the very best in their field.

examples.japanese: {超一流|ちょういちりゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シェフ→シェフ：05062_shefu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧だ。
examples.english: This is a dish prepared by a world-class chef.

examples.japanese: {超一流|ちょういちりゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
examples.english: Talent alone is not enough to become a world-class athlete.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{超一流|ちょういちりゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{輩出|はいしゅつ}→輩出：14396_haishutsu⟧してきた⟦{名門|めいもん}→名門：11955_meimon⟧だ。
examples.english: This university is a prestigious institution that has produced world-class researchers.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{超|ちょう}→超〜：28619_chou⟧ (super, beyond) and ⟦{一流|いちりゅう}→一流：03009_ichiryuu⟧ (first-rate). The prefix ⟦{超|ちょう}→超〜：28619_chou⟧ intensifies ⟦{一流|いちりゅう}→一流：03009_ichiryuu⟧, indicating a level above even first-rate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {超一流|ちょういちりゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧ (world-class athlete)
- {超一流|ちょういちりゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧ (top-tier company)
- {超一流|ちょういちりゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧ (world-class hotel)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {超一流|ちょういちりゅう}: beyond first-rate, world-class
- ⟦{一流|いちりゅう}→一流：03009_ichiryuu⟧: first-rate, top-class
- {最高峰|さいこうほう}: the very pinnacle, the highest peak
